name: WERK impact measurement and feedback contract
purpose: Version-bind a WERK reform/impact-map baseline, a real implementation event, KPI observations and review-only improvement hypotheses without converting correlation into causation or automatically adopting a policy change.

prerequisites.authoritative_reform_model: Existing WERK reform/model IDs and artifact refs must be reused from the canonical Impact Bridge registry; no parallel fiscal model.
prerequisites.implementation_event: Observed impact must never be claimed before a source-bound implementation event exists.

invalid_states: reform not belonging to current map
artifact not belonging to current map
stale or unknown canonical source-version token
source_binding.drift_guard: CI requires every map/reform/artifact in the canonical Impact Bridge registry to be present in the compiled runtime validator; a registry version/source-version change must update the validator in the same bounded change.
source_binding.boundary: The runtime validator is a compiled fail-closed view of the existing canonical registry, not a second registry or calculator.

separation_rules: observed value is not causal attribution
deviation is arithmetic in one declared unit, not proof of policy effect
attribution hypothesis remains explicitly unverified until separately evidenced
improvement hypothesis is review material, never an automatic policy decision

storage_contract.transport_boundary: trusted service_role; reviewer RPCs require active impact_reviewer

snapshot_semantics.deviation_from_baseline: observed_value - baseline_value in the same declared unit
snapshot_semantics.deviation_from_target: only if target_value is explicitly present; arithmetic only

review_contract.boundary: review-only; no automatic implementation, recommendation ranking, acceptance or rejection

negative_guards: measurement plan rejects unknown impact map
measurement plan rejects stale or unknown canonical source version
observation cannot be recorded without a measurement plan
implementation and observation source binding is mandatory
unit cannot silently change between a plan and an observation
snapshot never labels arithmetic deviation as causal effect
no automatic adoption of improvement hypothesis

tests: canonical Impact Bridge runtime parity guard
valid current authoritative tuple success and persistence
invalid observation period and missing plan fail closed

acceptance_boundary: Builder evidence proves authoritative source-binding hardening on Staging only. Independent Supervisor countercheck remains required before COUNTERCHECKED_STAGING; no real reform implementation, observed causal policy effect, provider activation or Production claim is made.
